candidate_replacement.hidden_definitions_description: Before compilation the evaluator renames these fixed definitions, which implement the target's behavior, in every source file, so a submission cannot reuse them by name.

test_programs.policy: The selected upstream tests reach an aborting commit and an instruction-fetch fence.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program completes with zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches and no observation mismatch.

fixed_test_patches.purpose: Report a writeback-complete instruction-fetch fence that aborts at commit without being forwarded.
